snippet.title: Empires of Steel Feature Video
snippet.description: This brand new video from game designer Brit Clousing from Atomicboy Software (who is also narrating) features the ever evolving and improving game EMPIRES OF STEEL by www.battlefront.com, and highlights the more than 100+ additions that have been made since its release.
